summary: Full-stack pass for IronFlow's new adaptive programming, lab pipeline, wearables and gym check-in features. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases green (100%) — includes updated 200->201 assertions on POST /api/workouts and POST /api/workouts/{id}/sets, new coverage for GET /api/programs shape + slug validation, POST /api/coach/adjust (LLM, recovery-gated caps target_rpe<=7 and load_pct_1rm<=70), lab report reuse (audit trail steps received/ocr/extraction/normalization/interpretation/write/callback all present, disclaimer + requires_professional_review true, 7 markers), GET /api/biomarkers/grouped (time-series shape), GET /api/notifications (lab_report_ready), POST /api/labs/upload 415 rejection for text/plain, wearables connect/sync/disconnect + Terra webhook mapping (2 metrics processed), sync-before-connect 409, gyms list (3 seeded) + valid checkin 201 + invalid FOO payload 422 + visits contain gym_name, and cross-user RLS 403 on /programs, /labs/reports and /biomarkers/grouped with ?owner_id=<demo_id>. Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844): auth login demo user works, /home shows all 4 quick actions (quick-program, quick-labs, quick-sources, quick-checkin) + rings-card with real simulated data (STRAIN 12, RECOVERY 83%, SLEEP 6h, HRV 70ms). /program renders active DELOAD program with W1 chip, Day 1 UPPER / Day 2 LOWER cards showing sets/reps/RPE/rest/1RM, adjust-btn + regenerate-btn present (did NOT trigger adjust in UI — recovery snapshot is 83% so it would return adjusted:false, and API layer is already covered). /labs shows lab_test.png report with 7 markers, tapping it renders disclaimer-banner and 7 marker cards with French summary/flags. /sources connect-fitbit -> sync-fitbit -> disconnect-fitbit round-trip works. /checkin: gym rows render, tapping checkin-<gym_id> shows checkin-result banner with 'CHECKED IN · IronFlow Bastille · Visit #3 · 7 more for a reward'. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch not in package graph — expo-camera used for QR).

issues: The 'ADJUST TODAY'S SESSION' button label overlaps the trend line icon just below the DELOAD phase chip — the icon (small waveform ~24px) sits between the W1 chip and the button, causing the button text to appear partially clipped on 390px width. Cosmetic only; button is tappable and reachable via testID adjust-btn.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cosmetic: tighten spacing in /app/frontend/app/program.tsx around the DELOAD phase icon so the 'ADJUST TODAY'S SESSION' label isn't visually crowded.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 765 lines and the new feature routers (program.py, labs.py, wearables.py) all import shared helpers from it — a circular-import risk if any of those helpers ever grow to need router state. Consider extracting shared helpers (clean, current_user, can_access_user_data, db, now) into a small deps.py module.
routers/labs.py MARKER_MAP is ~40 aliases hardcoded inline in the module (lines 37-72). For future expansion, move to a JSON registry loaded once at startup.

routers/wearables.py sync_source deletes prior simulated rows for the same device+user before inserting — good for keeping the series clean, but any non-simulated rows written via /webhooks/terra for the same device won't be touched, so re-syncing after receiving Terra data leaves a mix. Not a bug today, but worth a comment.

routers/labs.py run_pipeline swallows all exceptions with a bare `except Exception` (line 265) and stores str(e) — fine for user-visible status but the audit log detail is truncated to 2000 chars which is enough for now.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (extended: +16 new tests covering programs, labs pipeline reuse, wearables, gyms, and additional RLS scenarios; existing workout POST tests updated to expect 201)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home, program, labs, sources, checkin)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST-prefixed athlete users (RLS negative-path), TEST workouts + sets under demo user, 1 whoop connect/sync/disconnect cycle (deleted rows are cleared per sync), 1 Terra webhook payload processed against the ephemeral whoop terra_user_id, several gym check-ins against IronFlow Bastille. No mutation of the seeded active program or the seeded 'done' lab report — both were only read.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py run under pytest-xdist with -n 2 --dist loadscope (pinned in /app/backend/pytest.ini — do not override with -p no:xdist, that errors). The adjust test (TestPrograms::test_adjust_today_low_recovery) makes ONE LLM call (~2-30s at gpt-5.4); it tolerates both paths (adjusted:true with capped RPE/load, or adjusted:false when recovery is OK). The generate endpoint is intentionally NOT tested at 60-180s per LLM call — GET /api/programs already validates the seeded program's shape and slug integrity. LLM key present in backend/.env. Frontend testIDs are correctly exposed on all 4 new screens (program/labs/sources/checkin) — use '[data-testid="gym-<uuid>"]' first to enumerate gyms then click 'checkin-<uuid>', NOT the '^=' prefix match, because '[data-testid^="checkin-"]' also matches 'checkin-screen'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing cases. One playwright selector pitfall documented: `[data-testid^="checkin-"]` also matches the parent screen container `checkin-screen`, so pick the first result and it may land on the SafeAreaView. Fix used: enumerate gym UUIDs via `[data-testid^="gym-"]` then target `[data-testid="checkin-<uuid>"]` exactly.
